The '''LCK 2015 Spring''' was the first split of the 2015 [[League of Legends Champions Korea]] season, organized by Riot Games in partnership with OnGameNet. Officially titled the '''SBENU LCK 2015 Spring''' for sponsorship reasons, the competition took place in Seoul, South Korea, from January 7 to May 2, 2015, and featured eight teams. The regular season was played in a Double Round Robin format with Best-of-Three matches, followed by a Single Elimination King of the Hill Playoffs with Best-of-Five series. Teams competed for a ₩250,000,000 KRW prize pool, with the split champion qualifying for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2015|2015 Mid-Season Invitational]].

This split marked the beginning of the unified LCK branding, replacing the former [[Champions]] tournament naming used from 2012 to 2014. [[GE Tigers]] and [[Incredible Miracle]] earned their places in the league through the [[LCK/2015/Spring/Qualifier|2015 Spring Qualifier]], joining six returning teams from the [[Champions/2014/Summer|2014 Summer season]]. Matches were played primarily on Patch 4.21 through 5.7.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place''}} advance to the Finals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd and 4th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''5th and 6th place''}} qualify for [[LCK/2015/Summer|Summer split]].
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''7th and 8th place''}} will have to play in the [[LCK/2015/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]].
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination King of the Hill.
*** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
* Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season_Invitational/2015|Mid-Season Invitational 2015]]
